acceptance: Every holdout rejects without throwing; every anchor retains its expected outcome; all existing passing test names remain passing. A configured introspection endpoint is authoritative: failure must not fall back to structural JWT acceptance. Real loopback HTTP, no fetch/clock/crypto mocks. Full repository CI, security and Rust gates remain independent merge requirements.
timing: Deadline anchor uses 80 ms timeout and a 400 ms incomplete response; reject within 350 ms. Benchmark is five alternating complete probe trials, including listener and HTTP overhead, not provider throughput or cost.
